patch.value: Type the flag tables and preset dispatch against real SDK contracts

Annotate every flag table as FlagDefinition and migrate all 15 flag declarations from the deprecated type field to the canonical value_type, so the flag contract is enforced at compile time rather than resolved by the runtime fallback. Replace the last any-typed signature in the package, the preset dispatch table, with the real CommandHandlerContext.

All six flag tables annotated FlagDefinition; zero remaining deprecated type declarations; zero any in src; typecheck and full test suite green; flags verified to parse and behave correctly in a live pm host including boolean, string and dry-run combinations.
Flag contracts enforced at edit time; runtime behaviour unchanged.

46/46 tests green, typecheck clean. Verified in a live pm host: extension activates with activation_status ok and failed_count 0; 'presets list' and the boolean --json flag render correctly; 'presets apply kanban --dry-run' with and without the string flag --prefix, in both flag orders, left settings.json byte-identical and created no templates.

value.author: claude-orchestrator
value.text: FlagDefinition.type is deprecated in favour of value_type and only resolves via a runtime fallback (value_type ?? type). Untyped flag arrays hide that entirely, so the deprecation is invisible until the fallback is removed. Annotating the array is what surfaces it.

patch.value: Flag tables typed as FlagDefinition and migrated to value_type; preset dispatch table typed with CommandHandlerContext. Package is now free of any.
